xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4225: Per-issue continue/spec writers target the primary checkout and never commit (feedback-writer, session history, transitionXBriefOnMain)

plan.title: Per-issue continue/spec writers target the primary checkout and never commit (feedback-writer, session history, transitionXBriefOnMain)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Per-issue writers (feedback-writer clear/append, session-history appends on plan restart/reopen/resume, transitionXBriefOnMain at start/close-out/cancel/pan scope, and the swarm slot ledger) pass the project root to resolvePlanHome, so they write .pan/continues and .pan/specs into the operator's primary checkout and never commit. Readers (handoff-context, test-skip-waiver, the state-md route) read the primary copy while pan task / pan done write the workspace copy. The stray primary files block local main from following merged PRs (PAN-4224) and per-issue state diverges from the branch copy that ships. updateContinueState also overwrites an unparseable continue file with an empty state, wiping item statuses.
narratives.Proposal: Add resolveIssueWorkspacePlanHome (base workspace's plan home or null) and route the lifecycle-io continue adapters through it, so every existing caller lands in the workspace; skip when the workspace is gone. Readers read the workspace copy first, then the primary. Rename transitionXBriefOnMain to transitionIssueXBrief(planHome, …): start writes the workspace spec, close-out stops writing, cancel writes the workspace spec or skips, pan scope commits and pushes on main when no workspace exists. The server never commits in a workspace; pan done commits pending .pan/continues and .pan/specs before its rebase. Make continue writes atomic and refuse to overwrite unreadable files. Resolve the slot ledger to the base workspace. Update docs/XBRIEF.md and concerns.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Cleaning up stray files already present in the operator's primary checkout
- Any server-side git commit or push inside an issue workspace
- Cross-process locking of the continue file
- Changing command-deck.ts legacy .pan/continue.json reads, autonomous-work-dispatch.ts primary-spec reads, or issue-reads.ts
- A write path for remote (Fly) agents whose workspace is not on this host (their local writes skip)
- Removing feedback[] or sessionHistory[] from the continue schema
- Editing CLAUDE.md or src/cli/commands/start.ts
- Changing pan scope restore's completed/cancelled guard (a merged issue's spec now stays active on main, so restore refuses it)

autoDecisions.summary: Per-issue continue/spec/ledger writes go to the base workspace's plan home (<project>/workspaces/feature-<issue>), never a slot/strike workspace and never the primary checkout
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for one location, the workspace plan home; slot workspaces are separate sibling checkouts, so resolving from the caller's own path would split state

autoDecisions.summary: When the base workspace does not exist, writers skip (return false, log) instead of falling back to the primary checkout
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows 'commit on main or not write at all' after the workspace is gone; skipping keeps the primary checkout clean and the skipped data (feedback, resume breadcrumbs) is non-authoritative

autoDecisions.summary: The server never commits inside a workspace; server writes stay uncommitted and are committed by the agent's own pan task / pan done
autoDecisions.rationale: Start transitions run after spawn and feedback lands while the agent is live; a server commit would race index.lock and move HEAD under sha-pinned gates

autoDecisions.summary: pan done commits pending .pan/continues and .pan/specs before its rebase
autoDecisions.rationale: git rebase refuses a dirty tracked file, so without this commit point a server-dirtied continue file would break pan done

autoDecisions.summary: Close-out no longer writes the spec's completed status
autoDecisions.rationale: Completion is derivable from the merged PR and closed issue; no reader gates on a spec's completed status (verified by grep), and committing on main per close-out would add churn this issue removes

autoDecisions.summary: pan scope verbs write the workspace spec when the workspace exists, else commit and push on main like pan orders
autoDecisions.rationale: They are explicit operator actions; after the workspace is gone the issue requires a commit on main rather than an uncommitted primary write

autoDecisions.summary: Continue writes become atomic and updateContinueState refuses to overwrite an unparseable file; no cross-process lock
autoDecisions.rationale: Moving server writes into the same file pan task writes makes the empty-state overwrite a live item-loss path; fs-lock.ts is async-only and the sync call sites cannot use it

autoDecisions.summary: transitionXBriefOnMain is renamed transitionIssueXBrief(planHome, …) and loses its unused commitMessage parameter and always-false committed field
autoDecisions.rationale: The old name and header claim it commits on main, which it never does; an explicit plan-home parameter makes routing visible at each call site

autoDecisions.summary: The slot ledger keeps its .pan/continues/<ISSUE>.slots.json filename
autoDecisions.rationale: Minimal change; only its resolution moves from the primary checkout to the base workspace

items.title: Route lifecycle-io continue adapters through the base workspace plan home

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/xbrief/lifecycle-io.ts add baseWorkspaceFor (private), exported resolveIssueWorkspacePlanHome(projectRoot, issueId): string|null (resolvePlanHome(<project>/workspaces/feature-<issue>) when that dir exists, else null; project root via findProjectByPath(projectRoot)?.path ?? projectRoot) and exported issueContinueReadPlanHomes (workspace home first, then resolvePlanHome(root), de-duped). readContinueStateForIssue returns the first non-null state over issueContinueReadPlanHomes. appendContinueSessionEntryForIssue / appendFeedbackEntryForIssue / clearFeedbackForIssue return boolean: false (and log one line, write nothing) when resolveIssueWorkspacePlanHome is null; clearFeedbackForIssue also returns false without writing when continueStatePath(planHome, issueId) does not exist. src/lib/reopen.ts:52-56 assigns result.continueFileUpdated from the adapter's return value. Rewrite the existing test fixtures to create <tmp>/workspaces/feature-pan-1919/ and add the no-workspace and read-fallback cases. Do not touch planning-sessions.ts, agents/resume.ts, or routes/issues.ts.

items.title: Given <tmp>/workspaces/feature-pan-1919/ exists, when appendContinueSessionEntryForIssue(<tmp>, 'PAN-1919', …) runs, then it returns true, writes <tmp>/workspaces/feature-pan-1919/.pan/continues/PAN-1919.xbrief.json, and <tmp>/.pan does not exist
Given no base workspace, when appendFeedbackEntryForIssue runs, then it returns false and creates no file under <tmp>

Given continue files in both the workspace and the primary plan home, readContinueStateForIssue returns the workspace copy; with only the primary copy it returns the primary copy

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In src/lib/xbrief/continue-state.ts: writeContinueState writes `${path}.${process.pid}.tmp` then renameSync to path. Add exported ContinueStateUnreadableError(path, cause). updateContinueState: if the file is absent start from emptyState; if it exists and JSON.parse throws, throw ContinueStateUnreadableError and write nothing. readContinueState keeps its lenient null-on-error contract. No lock, no .gitignore change.
